record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: If S is a normal surface singularity that is not du Val, is the Hilbert scheme Hilb_d(S) reducible for every d?

evidence.quote: Problem XII. Is Hilbd(S) reducible for every normal surface S with a singularity which is not a du Val singularity?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a normal complex surface (a normal two-dimensional complex algebraic variety) that has at least one singular point which is not a du Val singularity (equivalently, not an ADE / Kleinian / rational double point). For each positive integer $d$, let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(S)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional closed subschemes of $S$ of length $d$.

Question: Is it true that for every such $S$ and for every $d \geq 1$, the Hilbert scheme $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(S)$ is reducible?
artifact.category_tag: Hilbert schemes of points on surface singularities
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem regarding Hilbert schemes of points on normal surface singularities. Related literature (e.g., work on Hilbert schemes on quotient and rational surface singularities) studies components and Euler characteristics but does not appear to settle whether reducibility holds for every $d$ whenever the singularity is not du Val. No source found resolving the problem in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Hilbert schemes of points on some classes of surface singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Hilbert schemes on quotient singularities of type A, D and cyclic (p,1), describing components and Euler characteristics.
status_evidence.claim: Related work addresses components of Hilbert schemes on specific singular surfaces but does not settle the general non-du-Val reducibility question.

status_evidence.title: Irreducible components of Hilbert schemes of rational surface singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Studies irreducible components of Hilb_d on rational surface singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on components exist for special classes; general claim for all non-du-Val normal surface singularities is not established.
